name: focus-stage
title: Focus Stage
description: Put one window center stage with a calm backdrop on every display, auto-hide the menu bar and Dock, and optionally hold notifications.
author: mirkopoloni

commands.name: toggle-focus-stage
commands.title: Toggle Focus Stage
commands.subtitle: Focus Stage
commands.description: Center the focused window, cover everything else with a plain backdrop on every display and hide the menu bar. Run again to restore everything.

commands.name: reset-focus-stage
commands.title: Reset Focus Stage
commands.subtitle: Focus Stage
commands.description: End any focus stage, even one that looks wrong or won't turn off, and restore windows, menu bar, Dock and notifications.

commands.name: focus-stage-menu-bar
commands.title: Focus Stage Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Focus Stage
commands.description: Show whether a focus stage is on, and start or end it from the menu bar.

preferences.name: windowSize
preferences.title: Window Size
preferences.description: How much of the screen the focused window takes.

preferences.name: glow
preferences.title: Appearance
preferences.label: Glow around the focused window
preferences.description: A soft halo in your accent color marks the window you are focusing on.

preferences.name: showLabel
preferences.label: Show “Focus Stage on”
preferences.description: A small label in the top-left corner of every display.

preferences.name: coverSameAppWindows
preferences.title: Behavior
preferences.label: Cover the app's other windows
preferences.description: The backdrop sits directly behind the focused window and covers all other windows, including the same app's. When off, the app's other windows stay visible next to it.

preferences.name: hideDock
preferences.label: Hide the Dock
preferences.description: Turns on “Automatically hide and show the Dock” during the session, and back off afterwards if it was off. The window can then use the Dock's space.

preferences.name: holdNotifications
preferences.label: Hold notifications until focus ends
preferences.description: No banners during the session; the ones that arrived show up when it ends, and all of them stay in Notification Center. Notification Center and desktop widgets don't open while it's on.
